content:
Maria Chen: quick sync — NVIDIA H200 / H100 availability looks like mid-q2, AMD MI300 GA target late q2, Habana/Gaudi expected in-market early q3. we need a single launch narrative for the marketplace and partner announcements.
Jake Patel: agree. main constraints: vendor embargo windows, marketplace certification, image/driver packaging.
Akshay Rao: can we tentatively target a rolling announcement cadence? GA + marketplace listing for H100/H200 first, then MI300 as it clears validation. that avoids a single huge PR we can't coordinate.
Denise Park: prefer a single multi-phase umbrella announcement so sales has one story. internal teams hate multiple press bursts.
Liam O'Neill: sales ops + marketplace require 6 weeks for listing and compliance checks. legal needs NDA/press signoff 2 weeks before public.
Helen García: SI partners (Kyndryl, Accenture) asked for a heads-up 4 weeks out for joint enablement playbooks.
Maria Chen: proposed timeline sketch:
```
- Week 0: internal partner briefing + embargo windows collected
- Week 2: package images + perf report (H100/H200) -> send to marketplace QA
- Week 4: legal/PR signoff, SI enablement docs shared under NDA
- Week 6: public announcement + marketplace listing live
- Week 10+: MI300 / Gaudi follow-up listings & case studies
```
Akshay Rao: that looks reasonable. question: do we need vendor-signed perf slides? NVIDIA usually requires approval for any published benchmark.
Denise Park: yes — vendor-approved numbers only. request them now. also ask vendors for embargo expiration dates in writing.
Jake Patel: ok I'm on vendor coordination. I'll ping NVIDIA AM and AMD rep today.
Maria Chen: action items:
- Jake: vendor signoff + embargo dates (due EOD Tue)
- Akshay: finalize perf report template and required artifacts for marketplace QA (due Fri)
- Denise: draft umbrella PR outline & sales one-pager (due next Wed)
- Liam: confirm marketplace listing timeline with ops & compliance (due Thu)
- Helen: draft SI enablement schedule and training checklist (due Fri)
Akshay Rao: reminder: marketplace QA needs:
- validated AMI/container image
- supported driver list + kernel compat notes
- perf runs with reproducible scripts
- minimal deployment manifest (helm/k8s)
Liam O'Neill: I've put a tentative listing slot on the ops calendar for 2026-05-12 -> will shift if vendor dates change.
partners-bot: Reminder: "Partnerships HW Sync" meeting scheduled in 2 days at 10:00am in #partnerships.
Helen García: one more thing — PR sequencing for social channels. we should stagger technical deep-dive content a week after the headline. keeps momentum.
Maria Chen: good point. add to PR outline.
Denise Park: legal note: don't commit to specific latency/cost numbers unless vendors approve and we have reproducible scripts. stick to qualitative claims until approved.
Jake Patel: I'll ask for vendor-approved slide decks and embargoed quotes. if one vendor misses the window we can still run marketplace listing without joint vendor quote — we'll call it "Redwood-verified" instead.
Akshay Rao: ok; for MI300/Gaudi we might need extra driver validation time (customers reported issues with some kernels). allocate +2 weeks contingency.
Maria Chen: final check — anyone blocking the proposed plan?
Liam O'Neill: no blockers from ops, just need dates from Jake.
Denise Park: no blockers, but want the PR draft by next Wed.
Helen García: no blockers from SI side.
Akshay Rao: no blockers, will start perf template now.
Maria Chen: thanks all. I'll compile this into a short action doc and share the link once done -> <https://docs.internal.redwood/reports/hw-marketplace-launch-draft>.
Jake Patel: noted. pinging vendors now. :rocket:
Maria Chen: closing the loop — expect updates here tomorrow. :thumbsup:
